name: [AddonRepo] Monitoring and alerting for addon deployments
description:
## Summary

Today a failed addon deployment is discovered when a partner notices and reports it. There is no alert, no dashboard and no named owner, so the time between a broken deploy and someone acting on it is bounded only by how quickly a partner complains. With 58 addon repositories live on 6,191 production e-shops, that is the wrong detection channel. This task adds monitoring of the deployment pipeline and alerting on failure, routed to a named owner rather than to a shared inbox nobody watches. Scope covers deploy success and failure, duration, and the health of the pipeline itself; it does not cover runtime monitoring of the deployed addons on merchant storefronts, which is a separate concern. Depends on the Vercel migration, because monitoring should be built against the target infrastructure, not the one being retired.

## Why?

A partner report is the current failure detector. That delays every fix by however long it takes a partner to notice and escalate, and it puts the cost of our outage on them.

## What?

A failed or stuck addon deployment raises an alert to a named owner. Deploy outcomes and durations are visible on a dashboard so a degrading trend is noticeable before it becomes an outage.

## Acceptance Criteria

A failed deployment raises an alert without any partner involvement

A stuck or never-finishing deployment also alerts, not only an explicit failure

Alerts route to a named owner documented in the team duty runbook

Deploy success rate and duration are visible on a dashboard

Alerting verified by deliberately failing a deployment in a non-production context
